channel.title: The Valley Times-News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Valley Times-News (valleytimes-news.com)

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Bill King: Icicle Pickles and Icicle Pickleballs
item.description: Bill King recalls discovering icicle pickles, braving freezing weather for pickleball, and reflecting on why we push through discomfort to do what we truly enjoy.

item.title: Job expo reveals career paths for students
item.description: Chambers County job expo connects 8th–12th graders with local employers, colleges, military and nonprofits, highlighting post-graduation career options close to home.

item.title: Valley council annexes two properties, celebrates American Heart Month
item.description: Valley council moves to annex two newly bought properties, hires legislative consultant, plans infrastructure fixes and events, and proclaims February American Heart Month.

item.title: Market Days returning next month
item.description: Valley Arts Council’s Market Days return March 7 to Langdale Farmers Market Pavilion, offering one-day outdoor shopping with artisan goods, plants, baked treats and food trucks.

item.title: County jail to receive upgrade
item.description: Chambers County jail will install an AI-powered sensor system in high-risk cells to track inmates’ vital signs.

item.title: Southern Union, Bradshaw Library team up for blanket drive
item.description: Southern Union’s Valley campus and Bradshaw Library are collecting new blankets through Feb. 28 for BraveHeart’s Warm Hearts Drive, supporting vulnerable residents across East Alabama.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Thomas Knapp: In Politics, the Celebrations Start Early and the Excuses Never End
item.description: After a Texas special election stokes blue-wave hopes, Thomas Knapp says midterm gains will bring only minor policy tweaks while both parties keep politics as usual.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Dean Collins: When Desperation Meets the Vine
item.description: Dean Collins reflects on Psalm 28 and John 15, showing how moments of desperation become opportunities to abide in Christ, surrender our crises, and trust God to supply our needs.

item.title: Dollar Tree opens in Lanett, Valley store gets refurbished
item.description: Dollar Tree opens a new Lanett store in the former Colorvision building and refreshes its Valley location across from Walmart with a brighter, newly painted interior.

item.title: Freeman discusses efforts to support local nonprofit work
item.description: Development director Ben Freeman details how the East Alabama Community Foundation, now affiliated with Central Alabama Community Foundation, is boosting grants to local nonprofits.
